CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.run_maintenance()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE changed integer;
BEGIN
  -- A second cron/manual invocation must not compete for the same rows.
  IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('zoi.run_maintenance',0)) THEN RETURN; END IF;
  WITH scores AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id,
      round(((CASE WHEN description IS NOT NULL AND length(description)>10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       +(CASE WHEN website IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       +(CASE WHEN address IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       +(CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       +(CASE WHEN primary_category_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))::numeric/5,3) AS completeness,
      least(1.0,round((CASE verification_status WHEN 'admin_verified' THEN 0.9 WHEN 'owner_verified' THEN 0.85
        WHEN 'partner_verified' THEN 0.8 WHEN 'source_verified' THEN 0.6 WHEN 'owner_claimed' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.3 END
        +CASE source_trust_tier WHEN 'official' THEN 0.1 WHEN 'partner' THEN 0.08 WHEN 'public_directory' THEN 0.05 ELSE 0 END)::numeric,3)) AS trust,
      CASE WHEN entity_type='event' AND zoi.maintenance_event_date(profile->>'end_datetime')<current_date THEN 0.2
        WHEN last_seen_at>now()-interval '14 days' THEN 0.95 ELSE 0.6 END AS freshness,
      CASE WHEN entity_type='event' AND zoi.maintenance_event_date(profile->>'end_datetime')<current_date-14
         AND coalesce(profile->>'recurring','')<>'annual' THEN 'archived' ELSE publish_status END AS next_status
    FROM zoi.listings
  ), due AS (
    SELECT s.* FROM scores s JOIN zoi.listings l USING(id)
    WHERE ROW(l.completeness_score,l.trust_score,l.freshness_score,l.publish_status)
      IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(s.completeness,s.trust,s.freshness,s.next_status)
    ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 1000
  )
  UPDATE zoi.listings l SET completeness_score=d.completeness,trust_score=d.trust,
    freshness_score=d.freshness,publish_status=d.next_status
  FROM due d WHERE l.id=d.id;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS changed=ROW_COUNT;
  INSERT INTO zoi.audit_log(actor,action,target_type,reason)
    VALUES('cron','run_maintenance','listing',format('Bounded score/freshness/archive maintenance: %s changed rows',changed));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.maintain_seo_identity_keys()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO zoi.seo_identity_keys VALUES
 (NEW.id,zoi.seo_name(NEW.name,NEW.city),zoi.seo_text(NEW.city),zoi.seo_text(NEW.region),zoi.seo_text(NEW.country),zoi.seo_text(NEW.address))
 ON CONFLICT (listing_id) DO UPDATE SET name_key=EXCLUDED.name_key,city_key=EXCLUDED.city_key,
 region_key=EXCLUDED.region_key,country_key=EXCLUDED.country_key,address_key=EXCLUDED.address_key;
 RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.schema_type(p_entity text, p_cat text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_entity='event' then 'Event'
    when p_entity='church' then 'Church'
    when p_entity='school' then 'EducationalOrganization'
    when p_entity='organization' then 'Organization'
    when p_entity='venue' then 'EventVenue'
    when p_entity in ('creator','artist') then 'Person'
    when p_entity='travel_place' then 'TouristAttraction'
    when p_entity='product' then 'Product'
    when p_entity='vendor' then 'Store'
    when p_entity='professional' then case p_cat
         when 'lawyers' then 'Attorney' when 'dentists' then 'Dentist'
         when 'doctors' then 'Physician' when 'accountants' then 'AccountingService'
         when 'realtors' then 'RealEstateAgent' when 'insurance' then 'InsuranceAgency'
         else 'ProfessionalService' end
    when p_entity='business' then case p_cat
         when 'restaurants' then 'Restaurant' when 'tavernas' then 'Restaurant'
         when 'bakeries' then 'Bakery' when 'cafes' then 'CafeOrCoffeeShop'
         when 'groceries' then 'GroceryStore' when 'specialty-food' then 'GroceryStore'
         else 'LocalBusiness' end
    else 'LocalBusiness' end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_read_authority_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF zoi.geography_read_authority_input(OLD) IS DISTINCT FROM zoi.geography_read_authority_input(NEW) THEN
   UPDATE zoi.geography_read_authority_epochs SET epoch=epoch+1 WHERE listing_id=NEW.id;
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_read_authority_input(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'schema',1,'listing_id',l.id,'entity_type',l.entity_type,'name',l.name,
 'legal_name',l.legal_name,'display_name',l.display_name,
 'address',l.address,'city',l.city,'country',l.country,'region',l.region,
 'province_state',l.province_state,'neighborhood',l.neighborhood,'region_id',l.region_id,
 'place_id',l.place_id,'region_code',l.region_code,'region_native',l.region_native,
 'website',l.website,'source_id',l.source_id,'source_url',l.source_url,
 'source_type',l.source_type,'source_trust_tier',l.source_trust_tier,
 'claim_status',l.claim_status,'verification_status',l.verification_status,
 'field_authority',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(k,v),'{}'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.field_meta)='object' THEN l.field_meta ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS f(k,v) WHERE k IN('name','legal_name','display_name','address','city','country','region','province_state','latitude','longitude','geo_precision','website','source_url','source_id','source_type','place_id')),
 'owner_user',l.owner_user_id,'owner_workspace',l.owner_workspace_id,
 'publish_status',l.publish_status,'moderation_status',l.moderation_status,
 'marketplace_status',l.marketplace_status,'duplicate_status',l.duplicate_status,
 'latitude',l.latitude,'longitude',l.longitude,'precision',l.geo_precision,
 'geo_provenance',l.profile->'_geo',
 'published_overrides',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(k,v),'{}'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.profile)='object' THEN l.profile ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS f(k,v) WHERE k IN('name','legal_name','display_name','address','city','country','region','province_state','neighborhood','website','latitude','longitude','geo_precision','location','locations','branches')),
 'source_authority',jsonb_build_object(
   'source_url',l.profile#>'{_enrich,source_url}','source_kind',l.profile#>'{_enrich,source_kind}',
   'identity_scope',l.profile#>'{_enrich,identity_scope}',
   'source_identity',l.profile#>'{_enrich,source_identity}',
   'source_scope_mismatch',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,source_scope_mismatch}'='true',false),
   'scope_mismatch_reason',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked_reason}'='source_scope_mismatch',false),
   'scope_review_required',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,scope_review_required}'='true',false),
   'organization_identity_quarantine',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,organization_identity_quarantine}'='true',false),
   'blocked',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked}'='true',false),
   'source_challenge',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,source_challenge}'='true',false)
 ))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.seo_pluralize(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when p ~ '(ch|sh|s|x|z)$' then p||'es'
    when p ~ '[^aeiou]y$'     then regexp_replace(p,'y$','ies')
    else p||'s'
  end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.set_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.seo_text(p_value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
 SELECT pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(p_value,'')), '[^[:alnum:]]+', ' ', 'g'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.seo_slug(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case when p is null then null else
    trim(both '-' from regexp_replace(lower(p), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g'))
  end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.maintain_seo_projection()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN UPDATE zoi.seo_identity_keys k SET slug=NEW.slug,entity_type=NEW.entity_type,updated_at=coalesce(NEW.updated_at,NEW.created_at),
 completeness=(((NEW.address IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.phone IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.website IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.latitude IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.description IS NOT NULL)::int)),
 ugly=(NEW.slug ~ '-[0-9a-f]{6}$')::int,
 is_indexable=coalesce(NEW.publish_status='published' AND NEW.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(NEW.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden' AND NEW.duplicate_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'confirmed_duplicate'
 AND nullif(btrim(NEW.slug),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(NEW.name),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND (NEW.city IS NOT NULL OR NEW.address IS NOT NULL OR NEW.website IS NOT NULL),false)
WHERE k.listing_id=NEW.id;
 RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.run_maintenance()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE changed integer;candidates uuid[];
BEGIN
  -- A second cron/manual invocation must not compete for the same rows.
  IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('zoi.run_maintenance',0)) THEN RETURN; END IF;
  candidates:=zoi.maintenance_candidate_ids();
  WITH selected AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT l.* FROM unnest(candidates) WITH ORDINALITY c(id,ord)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT row.* FROM zoi.listings row WHERE row.id=c.id FOR UPDATE OF row SKIP LOCKED)l
    ORDER BY c.ord
  ), scores AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id,
      round(((CASE WHEN description IS NOT NULL AND length(description)>10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       +(CASE WHEN website IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       +(CASE WHEN address IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       +(CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

      least(1.0,round((CASE verification_status WHEN 'admin_verified' THEN 0.9 WHEN 'owner_verified' THEN 0.85
        WHEN 'partner_verified' THEN 0.8 WHEN 'source_verified' THEN 0.6 WHEN 'owner_claimed' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.3 END
        +CASE source_trust_tier WHEN 'official' THEN 0.1 WHEN 'partner' THEN 0.08 WHEN 'public_directory' THEN 0.05 ELSE 0 END)::numeric,3)) AS trust,
      CASE WHEN entity_type='event' AND zoi.maintenance_event_date(profile->>'end_datetime')<current_date THEN 0.2
        WHEN last_seen_at>now()-interval '14 days' THEN 0.95 ELSE 0.6 END AS freshness,

         AND coalesce(profile->>'recurring','')<>'annual' THEN 'archived' ELSE publish_status END AS next_status
    FROM selected
  ), due AS (
    SELECT s.* FROM scores s JOIN zoi.listings l USING(id)
    WHERE ROW(l.completeness_score,l.trust_score,l.freshness_score,l.publish_status)
      IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(s.completeness,s.trust,s.freshness,s.next_status)

  UPDATE zoi.listings l SET completeness_score=d.completeness,trust_score=d.trust,
    freshness_score=d.freshness,publish_status=d.next_status
  FROM due d WHERE l.id=d.id;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS changed=ROW_COUNT;
  INSERT INTO zoi.audit_log(actor,action,target_type,reason)
    VALUES('cron','run_maintenance','listing',format('Bounded score/freshness/archive maintenance: %s changed rows',changed));
END;
$function$
